title: High quantum local differential privacy breaks entanglement
summary: Differential privacy provides a mathematical framework for guaranteeing privacy for sensitive data. In quantum information processing, the interaction of privacy constraints with quantum resources such as entanglement remains a question of interest. Given that the utility of many protocols, and often the presence of a quantum advantage, relies on quantum resources such as entanglement, it is crucial to understand when a privacy requirement for a quantum channel is compatible with the channel's ability to preserve entanglement. We study this question for quantum local differential privacy…
